parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Okehi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 697.56 | 0.29506 | 0.29506
2 | 10642 | 0.51943 | 0.81449
3 | 5533 | 35.32 | 39.13
4 | 5776.1 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Okehi
Curve type: KH-type
Aquifer depth: 0.81 m – 39.13 m (Layer 3, with possible continuation into Layer 4 below 39.13 m)
Recommendation: Target the moderately resistive sand/sandstone unit between approximately 0.8 m and 39 m for well screen placement, as it shows good thickness and resistivity consistent with a productive aquifer; drilling should proceed past 39 m to confirm whether the underlying high-resistivity layer (5776 ohm-m) represents a continuation of this aquifer or a deeper water-bearing zone.
